# Test submit.navigationCommentStyle.layout=simple:
# changes are listed top-first with trunk at the bottom,
# falling back to the tree layout where the stack forks above a change.

as 'Test <test@example.com>'
at '2025-01-18T21:28:29Z'

# setup
cd repo
git init
git commit --allow-empty -m 'Initial commit'
git config spice.submit.navigationCommentStyle.layout simple

# set up a fake GitHub remote
shamhub-setup
shamhub register alice
shamhub new origin alice/example.git
git push origin main
env SHAMHUB_USERNAME=alice
gs auth login

# main -> feature1 -> {feature2, feature3}
git add feature1.txt
gs bc -m feature1
git add feature2.txt
gs bc -m feature2
gs bco feature1
git add feature3.txt
gs bc -m feature3

gs bco feature1
gs stack submit --fill

shamhub dump comments
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/comments.txt

-- repo/feature1.txt --
feature 1

-- repo/feature2.txt --
feature 2

-- repo/feature3.txt --
feature 3

-- golden/comments.txt --
- change: 1
  body: |
    This change is part of the following stack:

    - #1 ◀
        - #2
        - #3

    <sub>Change managed by [git-spice](https://abhinav.github.io/git-spice/).</sub>
    <!-- gs:navigation comment -->
- change: 2
  body: |
    This change is part of the following stack:

    - #2 ◀
    - #1
    - `main`

    <sub>Change managed by [git-spice](https://abhinav.github.io/git-spice/).</sub>
    <!-- gs:navigation comment -->
- change: 3
  body: |
    This change is part of the following stack:

    - #3 ◀
    - #1
    - `main`

    <sub>Change managed by [git-spice](https://abhinav.github.io/git-spice/).</sub>
    <!-- gs:navigation comment -->
